item.title: Relief for Sonia, Rahul as Court Refuses to Take Cognisance of ED Chargesheet in National Herald Case
item.description: GUWAHATI: A Delhi court on Tuesday, December 16, refused to take cognisance of proceedings arising from a fresh FIR in the National Herald case, observing that the Enforcement Directorate’s (ED) probe is rooted in a private complaint rather than an FIR. The Rouse Avenue Court held that cognisance could not be taken because the ED’s case stems from a private complaint filed by BJP leader Subramanian Swamy and subsequent summoning orders by a magistrate, not from a registered FIR. item.title: Record Turnout as GPlus Guwahati Food Awards 2025 Voting Closes with 8 Lakh+ Public Votes
item.description: Public voting for the GPlus Guwahati Food Awards 2025 has officially concluded, recording a record-breaking 8 lakh votes, the highest ever in the history of the awards. The voting process, which began on November 28, witnessed unprecedented participation from food lovers across Guwahati.
